title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
summary: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.
body: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.
summaryZh: OpenAI重申针对符合条件的前沿模型API客户提供零数据保留（ZDR）政策，并预览了私人安全处理功能，旨在保障先进AI安全的同时不妥协用户数据隐私。原始信息显示：OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI重申为符合条件的前沿模型API客户提供零数据保留，并预览隐私安全处理功能。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
